entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt:
Build a single self-contained HTML file (inline CSS + JS, no build step, no
frameworks) for the personal website of Nicole Samareva, a 16-year-old
Bulgarian harpist. Read both uploaded .docx bios for all content — do not
invent any credentials, dates, or quotes.

PURPOSE, in priority order:
1. Let promoters, festivals, and private clients send a booking request.
2. Establish credibility fast — she has 40+ competition prizes.
3. Tell her story warmly enough that a non-musician wants to hear her play.

SECTIONS
- Hero: name, "harpist", one line of positioning, two buttons (Book / Listen).
  Space reserved for a full-bleed portrait — use a labelled placeholder.
- Biography: rewrite the source bio into flowing prose, ~150 words, first-
  person-adjacent but third person. Pull out 3–4 stat figures (age started,
  prizes won, countries performed in, album released at 12).
- Selected highlights: the 8–10 most impressive items only — World Harp
  Congress Toronto 2026, Young Musician of the Year 2025 (BNR Horizont),
  Grand Prix Veliko Tarnovo 2026, Basel 2026 1st prize, etc.
- Full awards archive: all prizes, grouped by year, newest first, collapsed
  behind a "Show all" toggle so the page doesn't become a wall of text.
  Year headers, prize name, place/date, result. Scannable, not a bulleted dump.
- Festivals & masterclasses: the teacher list is very long — render it as a
  compact wrapped tag cloud of names, not a paragraph.
- Album: "Nicole's Heavenly Harp", recorded at 12. Cover placeholder + short
  note + space for an embedded player.
- Booking: a real form — name, organisation, email, event type (recital /
  concerto / chamber / private event / masterclass), date, city, venue,
  programme notes, budget range, message. Client-side validation. On submit,
  compose a mailto: link with everything formatted, and leave a clearly
  commented single line where a Formspree/Netlify endpoint would swap in.
- Footer: contact, teacher credit (Dr. Kohar Andonyan, NMU "Lyubomir Pipkov"),
  social placeholders.

BILINGUAL
Bulgarian and English, toggled in the nav, no page reload. Bulgarian is the
default. Store both strings in a single JS content object so text is editable
in one place. Cyrillic must render properly — pick a font that supports it.

VISUAL DIRECTION
Print-editorial, the register of Monocle or a concert-hall season brochure —
not a startup landing page. Specifically:
- Large serif display type for headings, restrained sans for body.
- Warm paper
